label: Bible Study
prompt: My beloved spake, and said unto me, Rise up, my love, my _____ one, and come away.
verse: My beloved spake, and said unto me, Rise up, my love, my fair one, and come away.
note: The beloved calls at the window — spring has come, so come away.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: And all these _____ shall come on thee, and overtake thee, if thou shalt hearken unto the voice of the LORD thy God.
verse: And all these blessings shall come on thee, and overtake thee, if thou shalt hearken unto the voice of the LORD thy God.
note: Blessings that 'overtake thee' — not just waiting to be found, but chasing you down the road.

label: Sunday School
prompt: Jesus saith unto them, Fill the waterpots with water. And they filled them up to the _____.
verse: Jesus saith unto them, Fill the waterpots with water. And they filled them up to the brim.
note: The servants filled the waterpots to the brim — and by the time it was drawn out, the water had become good wine.

label: Deep Water
prompt: Canst thou bind the sweet _____ of Pleiades, or loose the bands of Orion?
verse: Canst thou bind the sweet influences of Pleiades, or loose the bands of Orion?
note: The Pleiades is a star cluster and Orion a constellation — God asks if Job can bind the one or loosen the other.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: The fear of man bringeth a _____: but whoso putteth his trust in the LORD shall be safe.
verse: The fear of man bringeth a snare: but whoso putteth his trust in the LORD shall be safe.
note: People-pleasing is a trap: 'the fear of man bringeth a snare' — but whoso trusts the LORD shall be safe.
